item.title: Eighteen agents audited a live curriculum. One lesson was teaching a false error.
item.description: I pointed an audit fleet at 34 published programming lessons: six auditors executing every code claim, six rewriters, six independent verifiers. 73 defects, 17 critical or high. Every one anchored to a verbatim quote. Thirteen minutes of wall clock.

item.title: Five pages, five agents, one design file — zero merge conflicts

item.title: The day my own quality gate blocked me

item.title: Your LLM feature needs a regression suite more than a better prompt
